stepTitle: Step 1: Find One Factor Using Factor Theorem
stepBody:
Test integer factors of the constant term (-6).

Possible values to test: $\pm 1, \pm 2, \pm 3, \pm 6$

Calculate $f(1), f(-1), f(2), f(-2)$, etc. until you find $f(a) = 0$.

Which linear factor $(x - a)$ is a factor of $f(x)$?

(Write your answer in the form $(x - a)$ or $(x + a)$)
